title: GLM-5.3 - Prefill and Decode Capacity
description: Measured Prefill and Decode capacity for GLM-5.3 on Comino Grando 8x RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell with 8 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB GPUs.

hardware.gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96 GB

report.subtitle: RadixArk GLM-5.3 on one eight-GPU TP8 vLLM replica, global concurrency 1 to 64, cold-uncached prefill

deployment.summary: one TP8 vLLM replica across eight GPUs behind haproxy (single backend); decode profile spliced at C24

notes: Frozen before measurement: Dell xe7740 deployment parameters verbatim by user decision (param raster skipped); corrected-cold aiperf invocation (num-dataset-entries 4000, sequential, per-(C,rep) seeds 600000+C*1000+rep); published 7-point axis [1,8,16,24,32,48,64].
Decode profile spliced like the published xe7740 series: C1-C24 on max_num_seqs 32 / cudagraph 128, C32-C64 on max_num_seqs 64 / cudagraph 256 (two container launches).
Engine: vLLM 0.26.1rc0 (voipmonitor/vllm base), InstantTensor load, modelopt_fp4, KV fp8, MTP-3, B12X MLA sparse, async scheduling; realized args verified from startup logs (segments/*/params.txt).
Prefill verified uncached on every rep: engine /metrics prefix_cache_hits/queries deltas, fail-closed gate <=1%, all reps 0.0%; client-side usage_prompt_cache_read_tokens 0.
Correctness gate 7/7 through the measured path after each fleet boot; B0 unloaded idle and B1-pre/post loaded-idle baselines captured (preflight/ + baselines/).
42 measured runs, 0 aiperf errors, 0 gate violations, 0 excluded runs.

container.image: local/radixark-glm53-r18-graph128:canary (seq32/graph128: prefill series + decode C1-C24) and local/radixark-glm53-r18-seq64-graph256:canary (seq64/graph256: decode C32-C64)
container.build: docker-commit canaries imported from the xe7740-04 study by image export (docker save/load); image IDs sha256:d45401bef4572d035c63ed257377c220b7db8867a0587430cd17cf3330eb6fd7 (seq32/graph128, commit layer ENV MAX_NUM_SEQS=32 GRAPH=128) and sha256:1e53276a801b8e53a51157820918537795bbe62651bcc216c38ff86fe4476bd6 (seq64/graph256, commit layer ENV MAX_NUM_SEQS=64 GRAPH=256). The xe7740-04 study vendors a configuration-equivalent Dockerfile (glm5.3/5-campaign/deployment/image/Dockerfile in that study).
container.caveats: The two measured images are docker-commit canaries that were never pushed to a registry and carry no registry digest (image IDs only). Rebuilding from the vendored Dockerfile is configuration-equivalent but not bit-identical (layer metadata differs). The decode series splices the two profiles at the C24/C32 boundary.

model.revision_note: ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts (layers 3-77); BF16 MTP layer 78

reproducibility.topology: Single TP8 replica across all 8 GPUs behind haproxy (single backend): frontend 127.0.0.1:8084 -> engine 127.0.0.1:8080, prometheus metrics on 127.0.0.1:8404. Decode profile spliced at C24. A profile IS an image: the entrypoint expands baked-in environment variables into the vLLM invocation (env interface: MAX_NUM_SEQS, GRAPH, MTP, MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS, MAX_MODEL_LEN, GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION, MOE_BACKEND, KV_CACHE_DTYPE, ...).

launch.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Engine launch, verbatim from results/comino-8x-rtx6000/raster-harness/run-coldgrid.sh
# boot() with variables expanded (NAME=glm53-engine,
# MODEL=~/bench/models/RadixArk--GLM-5.3-NVFP4--model).
# A profile IS an image: the entrypoint expands baked-in ENV into the vLLM invocation.
docker rm -f glm53-engine >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 5
docker run -d --name glm53-engine --ipc host --gpus all \
  -v ~/bench/models/RadixArk--GLM-5.3-NVFP4--model:/model:ro -p 8080:8080 \
  local/radixark-glm53-r18-graph128:canary
# wait_ready: curl http://127.0.0.1:8084/health until 200 (<=900 s), then
#   docker logs glm53-engine > startup.log
#   grep realized args (max_num_seqs, max_cudagraph_capture_size, num_speculative_tokens,
#   max_num_batched_tokens, tensor_parallel_size, kv_cache_dtype) > params.txt

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Measurement-path load balancer (preflight record).
# Config tracked verbatim at results/comino-8x-rtx6000/raster-harness/lb-haproxy.cfg:
#   frontend measured  bind 127.0.0.1:8084  default_backend engine
#   backend  engine    server engine-0 127.0.0.1:8080 check inter 3s
#   frontend stats     bind 127.0.0.1:8404  (stats enable, prometheus-exporter at /metrics)
docker rm -f glm53-lb >/dev/null 2>&1
docker run -d --name glm53-lb --network host \
  -v ~/bench/llm-bench/lb/haproxy.cfg:/usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg:ro \
  haproxy:3.2-alpine -f /usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg -V

client.workloads: Decode 8-in/768-out on the spliced decode profiles; Prefill 2048-in/8-out on seq32-graph128. One warmup per (kind, concurrency) from a disjoint seed pool (953601 decode / 953602 prefill, request-count max(C,32)), then 3 repetitions of 60 s windows (grace inf) with per-(C,rep) seeds 600000+C*1000+rep.

procedure.action: GLM-5.3 NVFP4 payload acquired with the revision resolved to the commit before transfer
procedure.detail: 177 files / 432.95 GiB; validation receipt on the box, with the trailing-region writer padding documented.

procedure.action: TP8 canary images imported from the xe7740-04 study and booted
procedure.detail: The images are docker-commit canaries never pushed to a registry (image IDs only, no registry digest). First boot ~3 min cache-warm: 433 GiB InstantTensor load in 38 s at 11.4 GB/s from the warm page cache; the Gen4 root NVMe bounds a true cold boot. Realized args were verified from each boot's startup log against the xe7740-04 recipe before any measurement.

procedure.action: User-approved contract: xe7740-04 deployment parameters verbatim (param raster skipped by decision), corrected-cold AIPerf invocation, published 7-point axis
procedure.detail: Frozen before measurement; recorded in the tracked controller script and the report-config provenance notes.

procedure.action: 14-point corrected-cold grid, decode spliced across two container launches at the C24/C32 boundary
procedure.detail: 42/42 runs, 0 errors, 0 excluded; all 42 fail-closed engine-side prefix-cache gates passed at 0.0% served (limit 1%); correctness 7/7 through the measured path after each boot; B1-pre and B1-post baselines captured.

procedure.action: comino-8x decode compared against the xe7740-04 published decode headline at the same point and profile
procedure.detail: C48 982.49 vs 927.37 (+5.94%, comparator glm5.3.decode.published-headline). The decode peak is 20.37% below the xe7740-04 corrected-cold decode peak at C128 - cross-axis by contract, since this campaign measured the published 7-point axis (max C64). Prefill ceiling parity: 6260.40 at C64 vs 6238.18 (+0.36%, comparator glm5.3-cold-20260909.prefill.published-headline). No prefill delta is stated against the cache-served published prefill series.
